section.content: 本实用新型涉及一种生物技术基因检测装置，包括检测箱，所述检测箱底部固定连接有液压缸，所述液压缸顶部设有液压伸缩杆，所述液压伸缩杆顶部固定连接有支撑平台，所述支撑平台顶部滑动连接有试管支撑架，所述试管支撑架顶部通过连接杆固定连接有试管限位架，所述试管限位架上开设有通孔，所述试管支撑架顶部设有检测试管，且所述检测试管贯穿试管限位架上的通孔，所述试管限位架上方固定连接有检测平台，所述检测平台底部通过输送管道连接检测试管，所述检测平台顶部固定连接有抽液泵、基因检测模块，提供了一个干净卫生、温度合适、真空的检测环境，提高了检测准确度，方便取放检测试管，便于使用。

The utility model relates to a biotechnological gene detection device, which comprises a detection box, wherein the bottom of the detection box is fixedly connected with a hydraulic cylinder, the top of the hydraulic cylinder is provided with a hydraulic telescopic rod, the top of the hydraulic telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a supporting platform, the top of the supporting platform is slidably connected with a test tube supporting frame, the top of the test tube supporting frame is fixedly connected with a test tube limiting frame through a connecting rod, a through hole is arranged on the test tube limiting frame, the top of the test tube supporting frame is provided with a detection test tube, the detection test tube penetrates through the through hole on the test tube limiting frame, the top of the test tube limiting frame is fixedly connected with a detection platform, the bottom of the detection platform is connected with the detection test tube through a conveying pipeline, the top of the detection platform is fixedly connected with a liquid pump and a, conveniently get and put detection test tube, convenient to use.

Biotechnological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biotechnology gene detection device belongs to gene detection technical field.

Background

The gene is a functional fragment on DNA molecule, is a basic unit of genetic information, is the most basic factor for determining all biological species, determines the life and death of people, is the reason of health, beauty and longevity, is an operator and a regulator of life, can detect the gene through a gene detection device, thereby judging the physical health condition of a detected person, but the gene detection device in the current market has complex structure and single function, can not effectively disinfect and sterilize a detection table, can not improve the temperature in a box body, has weak tightness, can not isolate the detection device from the outside air, influences the quality of gene detection, and simultaneously has troublesome treatment on a test tube after detection.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The to-be-solved technical problem of the utility model overcomes current defect, provides a biotechnology gene testing device, provides a clean health, the suitable, vacuum testing environment of temperature, has improved the detection accuracy, conveniently gets to put and detects the test tube, and convenient to use can effectively solve the problem in the background art.

In order to solve the technical problem, the utility model provides a following technical scheme:

a biotechnological gene detection device comprises a detection box, wherein a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected to the bottom of the detection box, a hydraulic telescopic rod is arranged at the top of the hydraulic cylinder, a supporting platform is fixedly connected to the top of the hydraulic telescopic rod, a test tube supporting frame is slidably connected to the top of the supporting platform, a test tube limiting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the test tube supporting frame through a connecting rod, a through hole is formed in the test tube limiting frame, a detection test tube is arranged at the top of the test tube supporting frame and penetrates through the through hole in the test tube limiting frame, a detection platform is fixedly connected to the upper part of the test tube limiting frame, the bottom of the detection platform is connected with the detection test tube through a conveying pipeline, a liquid pump and a gene detection module are fixedly connected to the top of the detection platform, the liquid pump is connected with the gene, the utility model discloses a pneumatic detection case, including detection case top fixedly connected with vacuum pump, on the inner wall respectively fixedly connected with electric heating rod, temperature sensor about the detection case, the equal fixedly connected with second sterilamp in pneumatic cylinder left and right sides, there is the sealing door through hinge swing joint on the detection case leading flank, from the top down is equipped with observation window, switch in proper order on the sealing door.

Further, both sides all pass through fixed plate fixed connection around test tube support frame, the spacing frame of test tube.

Further, the bottom of the liquid pump is fixedly connected with a conveying pipeline.

Further, test tube support frame bottom is equipped with the slide rail, the supporting platform top locate with slide rail assorted spout.

Further, the switch is respectively connected with the hydraulic cylinder, the liquid pump, the gene detection module, the vacuum pump, the electric heating rod, the temperature sensor, the first ultraviolet germicidal lamp and the second ultraviolet germicidal lamp through leads.

Further, sealing rubber pads are arranged at the joints of the sealing doors and the detection box, and test tube supporting grooves are formed in the tops of the test tube supporting frames.

The utility model discloses beneficial effect: a biotechnological gene detection device is characterized in that a detection test tube is placed on a test tube support frame and a test tube limiting frame at first when the biotechnological gene detection device is used, the test tube support frame is placed on a support platform through a slide rail, the detection test tube is convenient to take and place, a hydraulic telescopic rod is driven by a hydraulic cylinder to drive the support platform to ascend, so that a conveying pipeline is in contact with a sample in the detection test tube, the sample is pumped to a gene detection module by a liquid pump to be detected, the temperature in a detection box can be adjusted to be proper by an electric heating rod and a temperature sensor, the vacuum pump is started to pump the detection box to be in a vacuum state by closing a sealing door, the influence of bacteria in the air on a detection result is reduced, the detection box can be sterilized by a first ultraviolet sterilizing lamp and a second ultraviolet sterilizing lamp, a clean and sanitary detection environment with proper temperature and vacuum is provided, and, conveniently get and put detection test tube, convenient to use.

Drawings

The accompanying drawings are included to provide a further understanding of the invention, and are incorporated in and constitute a part of this specification, illustrate embodiments of the invention, and together with the description serve to explain the invention and not to limit the invention.

FIG. 1 is a view showing the internal structure of the detection box of the biotechnological gene detection apparatus of the present invention.

FIG. 2 is a view showing the structure of the outer tube of the biotechnological gene detecting apparatus of the present invention.

FIG. 3 is a structural diagram of the biotechnological gene detecting apparatus of the present invention.

Reference numbers in the figures: 1. a detection box; 2. a hydraulic cylinder; 3. a hydraulic telescopic rod; 4. a support platform; 5. a test tube support frame; 6. a test tube limiting frame; 7. a slide rail; 8. detecting the test tube; 9. a detection platform; 10. a liquid pump; 11. a gene detection module; 12. a first ultraviolet germicidal lamp; 13. a vacuum pump; 14. a delivery conduit; 15. an electrical heating rod; 16. a temperature sensor; 17. a second ultraviolet germicidal lamp; 18. a sealing door; 19. an observation window; 20. a switch; 21. a fixing plate; 22. and (4) switching.

Detailed Description

The preferred embodiments of the present invention will be described in conjunction with the accompanying drawings, and it will be understood that they are presented herein only to illustrate and explain the present invention, and not to limit the present invention.

As shown in FIGS. 1-3, a biotech gene testing device comprises a testing box 1, a hydraulic cylinder 2 is fixedly connected to the bottom of the testing box 1, a hydraulic telescopic rod 3 is arranged at the top of the hydraulic telescopic rod 3, a supporting platform 4 is fixedly connected to the top of the hydraulic telescopic rod 3, a test tube supporting frame 5 is slidably connected to the top of the supporting platform 4, a test tube limiting frame 6 is fixedly connected to the top of the test tube supporting frame 5 through a connecting rod, a through hole is formed in the test tube limiting frame 6, a test tube 8 is arranged at the top of the test tube supporting frame 5, the test tube 8 penetrates through the through hole in the test tube limiting frame 6, a testing platform 9 is fixedly connected to the upper side of the test tube limiting frame 6, the bottom of the testing platform 9 is connected with the test tube 8 through a conveying pipeline 14, the, further realizing that a conveying pipeline 14 contacts and detects the sample in the test tube 8, the top of the detection platform 9 is fixedly connected with an infusion pump 10 and a gene detection module 11, the infusion pump 10 is connected with the gene detection module 11 through a pipeline, the sample is pumped to the gene detection module 11 by the infusion pump 10 for detection, the inner wall of the top of the detection box 1 is fixedly connected with a first ultraviolet sterilization lamp 12, the top of the detection box 1 is fixedly connected with a vacuum pump 13, the left and right inner walls of the detection box 1 are respectively and fixedly connected with an electric heating rod 15 and a temperature sensor 16, the temperature in the detection box 1 can be adjusted to a proper temperature by the electric heating rod 15 and the temperature sensor 16, the vacuum pump 13 is opened to pump the interior of the detection box 1 to a vacuum state by closing a sealing door 18, the influence of bacteria in the air on the detection result is reduced, the left and right sides of the hydraulic cylinder 2 are both fixedly, utilize first sterilamp 12, second sterilamp 17 to disinfect in can to detection case 1, there is sealing door 18 through hinge swing joint on the detection case 1 leading flank, from the top down is equipped with observation window 19, switch 20 in proper order on the sealing door 18.

More specifically, the front and back sides of the test tube support frame 5 and the test tube spacing frame 6 are fixedly connected through a fixing plate 21, the bottom of the liquid pump 10 is fixedly connected with a conveying pipeline 14, the bottom of the test tube support frame 5 is provided with a slide rail 7, the top of the support platform 4 is provided with a slide groove matched with the slide rail 7, when in use, the test tube 8 is firstly placed on the test tube support frame 5 and the test tube spacing frame 6, the test tube support frame 5 is placed on the support platform 4 through the slide rail 7, the test tube 8 is convenient to take and place, the switch 20 is respectively connected with the hydraulic cylinder 2, the liquid pump 10, the gene detection module 11, the vacuum pump 13, the electric heating rod 15, the temperature sensor 16, the first ultraviolet germicidal lamp 12 and the second ultraviolet germicidal lamp 17 through leads, the junction of the sealing door 18 and the detection box 1 is provided with a sealing rubber pad, and the top of the test tube support frame 5 is provided with a test tube support groove 22.

The utility model discloses improve in: a biotechnology gene detection device, place the test tube 8 on the test tube support frame 5 at first when using, test tube spacing frame 6, place the test tube support frame 5 on supporting platform 4 through slide rail 7, conveniently get and put the test tube 8, drive hydraulic telescopic rod 3 through pneumatic cylinder 2 and drive supporting platform 4 and rise, and then realize the sample in the pipeline 14 contact test tube 8 of detection, utilize the drawing liquid pump 10 to draw the sample to gene detection module 11 department and detect, can adjust the temperature in the detection case 1 to suitable temperature with electric heating rod 15 and temperature sensor 16, through closing sealing door 18, open vacuum pump 13 and take out to the vacuum state in the detection case 1, reduce the influence of bacterium in the air to the testing result, utilize first sterilamp 12, the second sterilamp 17 can be disinfected in the detection case 1, a clean health is provided, The temperature is suitable, the vacuum detection environment, the detection accuracy is improved, the test tube is convenient to take and place, and the use is convenient.

The above is the preferred embodiment of the present invention, and the technical personnel in the field of the present invention can also change and modify the above embodiment, therefore, the present invention is not limited to the above specific embodiment, and any obvious improvement, replacement or modification made by the technical personnel in the field on the basis of the present invention all belong to the protection scope of the present invention.
